sentences.en: Jesus walked by the sea of Galilee
sentences.pt: Jesus andava junto ao mar da Galileia

sentences.en: Peter was a fisherman
sentences.pt: Pedro era um pescador

sentences.en: Jesus called four fishermen to be his disciples
sentences.pt: Jesus chamou quatro pescadores para serem seus discípulos

sentences.en: Simon and Andrew were casting a net into the sea
sentences.pt: Simão e André lançavam a rede ao mar

sentences.en: Follow me
sentences.pt: Vinde após mim

sentences.en: I will make you fishers of men
sentences.pt: Eu vos farei pescadores de homens

sentences.en: They left their nets and followed him
sentences.pt: Eles deixaram as redes e o seguiram

sentences.en: James and John were in a boat with Zebedee
alt: James and John were in a ship with Zebedee
sentences.pt: Tiago e João estavam num barco com Zebedeu

sentences.en: Jesus saw them mending their nets and called them
sentences.pt: Jesus os viu consertando as redes e chamou-os

sentences.en: They immediately left the boat and their father
alt: They immediately left the ship and their father
sentences.pt: Eles deixaram imediatamente o barco e seu pai

sentences.en: The disciples followed Jesus
sentences.pt: Os discípulos seguiram Jesus

sentences.en: Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching and healing
sentences.pt: Jesus percorria toda a Galileia, ensinando e curando

verse.text: Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
verse.pt: Vinde após mim, e eu vos farei pescadores de homens.

reading.text: Jesus walked by the sea of Galilee. He saw Simon, called Peter, and Andrew his brother. Then he saw James and John in a boat with their father Zebedee. He called them, and they followed him.
reading.pt: Jesus andava junto ao mar da Galileia. Viu Simão, chamado Pedro, e André, seu irmão. Depois viu Tiago e João num barco com seu pai, Zebedeu. Ele os chamou, e eles o seguiram.
reading.q: Who was in the boat with James and John?

dialogue.line: Peter, leave your nets and follow me.
dialogue.pt: Pedro, deixe as redes e siga-me.
options: Yes, Lord! I will follow you.
No, I must mend my net first.
dialogue.answer: Yes, Lord! I will follow you.

quiz.q: What were Peter and Andrew doing when Jesus saw them?
options: Casting a net into the sea
quiz.answer: Casting a net into the sea
quiz.explain: Simão e André lançavam as redes ao mar, porque eram pescadores (Mateus 4:18).

sentences.en: Jesus taught his disciples to pray
sentences.pt: Jesus ensinou os seus discípulos a orar

sentences.en: When you pray, go into your room and shut the door
alt: When you pray, enter into your room and shut the door
sentences.pt: Quando orares, entra no teu aposento e fecha a tua porta

sentences.en: Our Father in heaven
sentences.pt: Pai nosso que estás nos céus

sentences.en: Hallowed be thy name
sentences.pt: Santificado seja o teu nome

sentences.en: Thy kingdom come
sentences.pt: Venha o teu Reino

sentences.en: Thy will be done
sentences.pt: Seja feita a tua vontade

sentences.en: Give us this day our daily bread
sentences.pt: O pão nosso de cada dia nos dá hoje

sentences.en: Forgive us our debts
sentences.pt: Perdoa-nos as nossas dívidas

sentences.en: As we forgive our debtors
sentences.pt: Assim como nós perdoamos aos nossos devedores

sentences.en: Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil
alt: Do not lead us into temptation, but deliver us from evil
sentences.pt: Não nos induzas à tentação, mas livra-nos do mal

sentences.en: For thine is the kingdom, the power, and the glory
alt: For yours is the kingdom, the power, and the glory
sentences.pt: Porque teu é o Reino, e o poder, e a glória

sentences.en: If you forgive men, your Father will also forgive you
sentences.pt: Se perdoardes aos homens, vosso Pai também vos perdoará

verse.text: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
verse.pt: Pai nosso que estás nos céus, santificado seja o teu nome.

reading.text: Jesus said: When you pray, do not use many vain words. Your Father knows what you need before you ask him. Then he taught them: Our Father which art in heaven, hallowed be thy name.
reading.pt: Jesus disse: Quando orardes, não useis de vãs repetições. Vosso Pai sabe o que vos é necessário antes de vós lho pedirdes. Depois ele os ensinou: Pai nosso, que estás nos céus, santificado seja o teu nome.
reading.q: What does the Father know before we ask him?

options: Our Father which art in heaven...
Give me five loaves and two fishes.
dialogue.answer: Our Father which art in heaven...
dialogue.answerPt: Pai nosso que estás nos céus...

quiz.q: What do we ask God to give us this day?
quiz.explain: O pão nosso de cada dia nos dá hoje (Mateus 6:11).

sentences.en: A great crowd followed Jesus
sentences.pt: Uma grande multidão seguiu Jesus

sentences.en: Jesus told the disciples to feed the crowd
sentences.pt: Jesus mandou os discípulos dar de comer à multidão

sentences.en: Five loaves and two fishes
sentences.pt: Cinco pães e dois peixes

sentences.en: He commanded the crowd to sit down on the grass
sentences.pt: Mandou que a multidão se assentasse sobre a erva

sentences.en: Jesus blessed the bread and the fish
sentences.pt: Jesus abençoou o pão e o peixe

sentences.en: About five thousand men ate and were filled
sentences.pt: Quase cinco mil homens comeram e ficaram saciados

sentences.en: Twelve baskets were left
sentences.pt: Sobraram doze cestos

sentences.en: Jesus came to them, walking on the sea
sentences.pt: Jesus foi ter com eles, andando por cima do mar

sentences.en: Be of good cheer, it is I, be not afraid
alt: Be of good cheer, it is I, do not be afraid
sentences.pt: Tende bom ânimo, sou eu, não temais

sentences.en: Peter walked on the water to go to Jesus
sentences.pt: Pedro andou sobre as águas para ir ter com Jesus

sentences.en: Peter began to sink and cried, Lord, save me
sentences.pt: Pedro começou a afundar e clamou: Senhor, salva-me!

sentences.en: O you of little faith, why did you doubt?
alt: You of little faith, why did you doubt?
sentences.pt: Homem de pequena fé, por que duvidaste?

verse.text: He took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed.
verse.pt: Tomou os cinco pães e os dois peixes e, olhando para o céu, abençoou.

reading.text: In the night, the disciples were in a boat, and the wind was contrary. Jesus came to them, walking on the sea. Peter walked on the water, but he was afraid and began to sink. Jesus stretched out his hand and caught him.
reading.pt: De noite, os discípulos estavam num barco, e o vento era contrário. Jesus foi ter com eles, andando sobre o mar. Pedro andou sobre as águas, mas teve medo e começou a afundar. Jesus estendeu a mão e o segurou.
reading.q: What did Jesus do when Peter began to sink?
options: He stretched out his hand and caught him
He went back to the boat
reading.answer: He stretched out his hand and caught him

dialogue.line: Lord, we have only five loaves and two fishes.
dialogue.pt: Senhor, temos só cinco pães e dois peixes.

quiz.q: How many men ate of the loaves and fishes?
quiz.explain: Os que comeram foram quase cinco mil homens, além das mulheres e crianças (Mateus 14:21).
